title: 第1358章 对不起你们第1357章 戏耍
lines: 任何一个逃走的人都有医门的人专门去盯上，追上进行灭杀。
很快，余英杰的人又有不少人被追杀，只余下了几十人。
医门这边的孕婴大能也有伤亡，不过伤者多，死的人并没多少，因为生死危机时刻高山总会出现。
下方的反扑中，医门也开始了全面的围杀，外来修炼者被杀的狼狈逃窜，无数人选择缴械投降。
余英杰左右环顾了一圈知道大势已去，他提前下来本是为了建功立业的可现在看来是要重蹈弟弟覆辙了。
余英杰自然不想死，见击杀高山的机会不大了，开始组织人进行突围。
他们现在要做的就是活下去，等到修炼者大军降临华夏，新仇旧账再找高山一并清算。
“所有人跟我一起突围。”余英杰组织着仅剩的六十多人，准备杀出一条血路出去。
余下的人都心里咒骂，心想早就该如此了，现在人剩的不多了，再想突围肯定很难。
高山哪里会让他们走，拦在了对前方，持剑而立，讥讽道:“不是要杀我吗，怎么突然想走了？”
“你的命我要定了，就再让你活几天，杀出去！”余英杰指挥着人向外冲杀？
高山冷哼道:“想走？晚了！”
他一人一剑，无人能冲过去。
纵然身受重创也要将人全部拦下。
这时候，医门的人也赶来，一起阻拦进行击杀。
余英杰带着人一轮轮冲锋，他们也都是拿出了搏命的本事，因为都知道若是不能冲出去就都要死在这里，只有冲出去才有活路。
可惜，每次感觉要打开缺口了，高山就突然杀至。
衣衫破烂，浑身染血的高山此时就犹如一道不可逾越的天堑一次次横在他们身前。
余英杰带着人一次次被打退，身边的人也越来越少，他也越来越绝望。
经过了十几次冲锋，身边只剩下数人。
“我们投降，我们不打了。”有的人真的怕了，因为再冲下去也不可能冲出去，必死无疑。
高山轻蔑道:“投降？晚了。”
说着，一剑便斩下将说话人一剑斩成了两半。
“我跟你拼了。”余英杰也知道这次真的栽了所以想和高山同归于尽，朝着高山搏杀而来。
“你们去解决其它人。”高山一人迎上余英杰。
余英杰实力还是很强的，玩命起来还是很恐怖的。
高山不希望在最后时刻再有损伤，所以独自对上余英杰。
两个人打的你来我往，你一拳我一剑的。
灵力几乎都已经耗尽，纯粹就是肉身的对拼。
高山一次次被余英杰轰击，余英杰也一次次被高山以纯阳剑砍中。
经过了数十回合的搏杀，余英杰再出力气，“砰”的摔落在地。
高山同样也是气喘吁吁，拄着剑缓缓起身，一字一句道:“杀我？你还不配！”
content_en:
Anyone who escapes will have medical personnel to keep an eye on them, catch them up and kill them.
Soon, many of Yu Yingjie's people were hunted down, and only a few dozen were left.
The maternal and infant experts on the medical side also suffered casualties, but there were many injured and not many dead, because mountains always appear in moments of life-and-death crisis.
During the counterattack below, the medical sect also began a full-scale siege. The outside cultivators were killed and fled in panic, and countless people chose to surrender.
Yu Yingjie looked around and knew that the situation was over. He came down early to make contributions, but now it seemed that he was going to make the same mistake as his younger brother.
Yu Yingjie naturally didn't want to die. Seeing that the chance of killing Gao Shan was slim, he began to organize people to break out.
What they have to do now is to survive until the army of cultivators comes to China, and they will settle old and new scores with Gao Shan.
"Everyone come with me to break out." Yu Yingjie organized the remaining 60 people and prepared to fight a bloody way out.
The remaining people were cursing in their hearts, thinking that it should have been like this a long time ago. Now that there are not many people left, it will definitely be difficult to break out.
How could Gao Shan let them go? He stopped in front of them, stood with a sword, and said sarcastically: "Aren't you going to kill me? Why do you want to leave all of a sudden?"
"I'm going to decide your life. I'll let you live for a few more days and then fight out!" Yu Yingjie directed the people to rush out and kill?
Gao Shan snorted coldly: "Want to leave? It's too late!"
With one man and one sword, no one can rush past him.
Even if you are seriously injured, you must stop them all.
At this time, people from the medical sect also came to stop him and kill him.
Yu Yingjie led his men to charge one after another, and they all used their life-saving skills, because they all knew that if they couldn't rush out, they would all die here, and the only way to survive was to rush out.
Unfortunately, every time it feels like a gap is about to open, the mountain suddenly approaches.
The mountain, whose clothes were in tatters and covered in blood, was like an insurmountable chasm crossing in front of them again and again.
Yu Yingjie and his men were beaten back again and again, and there were fewer and fewer people around him, making him more and more desperate.
After more than a dozen charges, there were only a few people left.
"We surrender, we won't fight." Some people were really scared, because if they continued to charge, they would not be able to get out, and they would definitely die.
Gao Shan said contemptuously: "Surrender? It's too late."
As he spoke, he cut the speaker in half with a single slash of his sword.
"I'll fight with you." Yu Yingjie also knew that he was really in trouble this time, so he wanted to die with Gao Shan and came to fight towards Gao Shan.
"You go and deal with the others." Gao Shan greeted Yu Yingjie alone.
Yu Yingjie is still very strong, and it is terrifying to risk his life.
Gao Shan didn't want to be hurt again at the last moment, so he faced Yu Yingjie alone.
The two of them fought back and forth, punching each other and sword-fighting each other.
The spiritual power has almost been exhausted, and it is purely a physical fight.
Gao Shan was bombarded by Yu Yingjie again and again, and Yu Yingjie was struck by Gao Shan with the Pure Yang Sword again and again.
After dozens of rounds of fighting, Yu Yingjie used his strength again and fell to the ground with a bang.
Gao Shan was also panting. He slowly stood up with his sword and said word by word: "Kill me? You are not worthy!"
